subject: world_language
concept: Recounting a simple sequence of past events using time-order words (first, then, after)
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'narrate simple sequences' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sequences event cards and narrates them aloud using time-order words in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a time-order word to its correct position in a sequenced story
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short 2-3 sentence account of past events using time-order words

misconception_flags: uses time-order words but in an order that contradicts the actual event sequence

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
